scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Govt of India
benefit: Maintenance allowance up to ₹1,600/month + compulsory course fees + book allowance + disability allowance

criteria.label: Beneficiary Category (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 40%+)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must have certified benchmark disability of not less than 40%.

criteria.label: Pursuing Post-Matric / Higher Education course
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be enrolled in post-matric studies (Class 11 to Post-Graduation / Technical Degree).

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹2,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar must be linked for DBT payment.

application.office_name: State Department of Social Welfare / DEPwD
process_steps: Choose Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
Upload verified documents and marks card
State level verification and direct DBT disbursement
